title: Standalone editorial quality tool (working name TBD)
description:
# Standalone editorial quality tool (working name TBD)

## Intent

Spin the automated **quality-first editorial loop** (diagnose slop-like weakness, propose constrained rewrite options, human-steered apply with markup/diff) out of Papyrus into a **clean, isolated project**. Name undecided. Until then, planning and early implementation live on the Papyrus board; the long-term home is a separate repo/package.

## Guardrail

Quality outcomes, **not** detector-score evasion. North-star remains human acceptance after factual review.

## What already exists (reparented)

Epic `PPY-54055d` — interactive editorial rewrite loop (diagnose → options → steer/apply/provenance), currently implemented in-tree under `papyrus_content` (`editorial_diagnosis`, `editorial_style`, CLI commands). Style profile + diagnostic JSON stories are closed; rewrite options / verifier / steer-apply remain open.

## Milestones (epics under this initiative)

1. **In-Papyrus MVP loop** (`PPY-54055d`) — finish interactive diagnose → options → verify → human apply while still in-tree.
2. **Decouple: portable CLI + Python SDK** — extract into a standalone package with its own local style-rules config; no Papyrus imports; installable and runnable alone.
3. **Evaluations harness** — regression evals for diagnose findings and rewrite-option quality (fixtures, metrics, CI-friendly).
4. **Papyrus consumes via SDK** — wire newsroom / Tactus procedures to call the SDK with Papyrus-supplied style profiles and drafts; CLI remains for humans.

## Non-goals (for this initiative)

- Renaming / marketing the new project (pick later).
- Detector-gaming “humanizer” products.
- Auto-publishing externally attributable copy without a human gate.
